rules.name: domain_similarity
rules.statute_ref: IT Act 2000 §66D — Cheating by personation using computer resources
rules.explanation_template: This domain closely resembles '{similar_domain}' (similarity: {score}%). This could be a phishing or typosquatting attempt designed to impersonate a legitimate website and steal your credentials.

rules.name: pre_consent_tracking
rules.statute_ref: DPDP Act 2023 §6 — Consent requirement; IT Rules 2021 Intermediary Guidelines
rules.explanation_template: Tracking script '{script_name}' was loaded before any consent interaction was detected on this page. Under DPDP Act 2023, personal data processing requires valid prior consent.

rules.name: phishing_clone
rules.statute_ref: IT Act 2000 §66C — Identity theft; §66D — Cheating by personation

structural_check.expected_nearby: input[type='password'], input[type='email'], input[name*='card'], input[name*='credit'], input[name*='cvv'], input[name*='expir'], input[autocomplete='cc-number']

rules.explanation_template: This page contains a login or payment form on a domain that closely resembles a known legitimate site. Combined with domain similarity, this is a strong indicator of a phishing attack attempting to steal your credentials.
